app_info.subtitle: Work your B2B lead pipeline
app_info.description:
Leadbay is a B2B prospecting workspace that sources and scores companies against a seller's ideal customer profile. This app connects ChatGPT to the user's own Leadbay account so they can work that pipeline in plain language instead of clicking through the web app.

Typical sessions: pull the day's fresh, AI-scored prospects and skim the best ones; research a single company in depth (qualification signals, contacts, recent web findings, past notes and activity); draft a personalised outreach email or call opener for a named contact; plan which accounts to visit in a city before a trip; import a list of companies and have Leadbay qualify them; and log what was actually sent so the pipeline stays honest.

It also covers the account admin a seller needs along the way: managing lenses (saved audiences), campaigns, contacts, CRM custom fields, and the qualification questions every lead is scored against.

Lead and contact data is read and written only in the signed-in user's own Leadbay workspace, over an OAuth token the user grants. Two consent-gated tools are the exception and send nothing else: "send feedback" delivers a message the user wrote to the Leadbay team's Sentry inbox, and "report a problem" emits one product-analytics event to PostHog carrying the user's own words. Both fire only when the user asks or accepts an offer, and neither carries lead or contact data. The app does not send email or messages on the user's behalf — it drafts outreach and records the outcome the user reports.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches the active lens wishlist and AI qualification summaries from Leadbay.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the user's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to read lens leads and qualification summaries, with data staying inside that customer workspace and never being published, posted, or emailed to a third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: Retrieves wishlist lead pages and qualification summaries from Leadbay without changing saved lead, lens, campaign, or quota state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the Monitor follow-up view; an optional set_filter argument first persists that filter server-side via POST /monitor/filter.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reaches the user's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for Monitor filters and follow-up leads, and the returned account data is not published to a public URL, posted elsewhere, or emailed to an outside party.
justifications.destructive_justification: Loads Monitor follow-ups and, when requested, updates the saved Monitor filter used for future Monitor reads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads mapped follow-up leads from the Monitor view; an optional set_filter argument first persists that filter server-side via POST /monitor/filter.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to retrieve geocoded Monitor leads for map display, without publishing, posting, or emailing those leads outside the workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Delegates to the Monitor follow-up reader and may save a Monitor filter for later reads when the caller supplies filter parameters.

justifications.read_only_justification: Combines Leadbay Monitor follow-up reads with fresh wishlist reads to assemble a city itinerary.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr account for known and fresh leads used in the tour plan, keeping those leads within the private workspace rather than posting or emailing them externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Builds an itinerary from existing Leadbay lead and Monitor data while leaving campaigns, lenses, contacts, and billing state unchanged.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists campaigns and roll-up statistics from the user's Leadbay account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to read campaign metadata and statistics, with no publication to a public URL or third-party message channel.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reads campaign summaries from Leadbay and returns them without modifying campaign membership or campaign metadata.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads paginated per-lead progression inside a selected Leadbay campaign.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts the user's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for campaign lead progression, and the data remains confined to that customer's account output.
justifications.destructive_justification: Fetches campaign lead progression rows without adding, removing, or updating campaign records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads campaign contacts and lead rows to assemble a cold-calling sheet.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves campaign leads and contacts from the user's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, and it does not send the call sheet to any outside email, posting, or public publishing service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Compiles a call sheet from campaign data without changing contacts, lead statuses, notes, or campaign membership.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a lead profile, qualification answers, contacts, web signals, and activity history; it also fire-and-forget logs LEAD_SEEN and LEAD_CLICKED via POST /interactions to feed lens refresh.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for lead research and interaction logging, keeping the lead data inside the private workspace with no public posting or third-party email.
justifications.destructive_justification: Hydrates one Leadbay lead and records lightweight interaction telemetry used for lens refresh without altering the lead's CRM status, contacts, notes, or audience filters.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the user's Leadbay wishlist and suggestion indexes, then uses the Leadbay resolver to identify a likely matching lead.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the user's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for company-name search and lead resolution, and matching results are returned only in the chat response rather than published or emailed externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Runs search and resolve lookups that identify candidate leads without creating, deleting, or editing Leadbay records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the organization's Leadbay AI qualification questions used for lead scoring.
justifications.open_world_justification: Requests the question catalog from the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace and sends it to no public, posting, billing, or email destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns the current qualification-question list without changing scoring criteria or triggering regeneration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a packaged guided walkthrough manifest without backend access.
justifications.open_world_justification: Serves static local walkthrough content and reaches no Leadbay API, Stripe, Sentry, PostHog, public URL, or email service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Provides local onboarding instructions and leaves all workspace, billing, memory, and telemetry state untouched.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a lead's custom-field values and any needed CRM field definitions; it also fire-and-forget logs LEAD_SEEN and LEAD_CLICKED via POST /interactions to feed lens refresh.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts the user's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for lead custom fields and interaction logging, keeping the field values inside the customer's account response.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns stored custom-field values and records lightweight interaction telemetry without editing field definitions or lead values.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads notes and activity history for one Leadbay account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to retrieve one account's historical notes and activities, without posting or emailing that history to outsiders.
justifications.destructive_justification: Loads account history from Leadbay and returns it without appending notes or changing activities.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the Monitor portfolio and cached per-lead web_fetch signals; an optional set_filter argument persists the Monitor filter first via POST /monitor/filter.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to read Monitor leads and cached web research, and the scan results are not published, posted, or emailed outside that workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Scans cached Leadbay portfolio signals and may update the saved Monitor filter that scopes later Monitor reads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads team KPI user metrics and trend data from Leadbay.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for team activity metrics, with no transfer to public pages, posting systems, or email recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns KPI and trend data without editing user records, goals, activities, or workspace settings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads previously enriched titles by posting a transient lead selection, previewing enrichment metadata, and clearing the selection again in a finally block with no lasting change.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to preview enrichment metadata for selected leads, and that title data remains within the private account response.
justifications.destructive_justification: Temporarily sets Leadbay selection state for the preview request and clears it before returning, leaving no durable selection, enrichment, or contact change.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads quota status, lens state, notification summaries, telemetry preference, and local memory context for the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts the user's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for account status and combines it with local MCP context, without publishing or emailing the account details externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Summarizes account state and local context without changing quotas, lenses, notifications, telemetry settings, or memory entries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads local and Leadbay-backed bulk enrichment job progress.
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, and possibly local tracker state, for enrichment progress without sending contact data to any public or third-party destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Polls enrichment status and contacts for an existing job without launching new enrichment or spending additional quota.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads local and Leadbay-backed import or qualification job status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace and local bulk tracker for qualification progress, keeping status details in the private account context.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reports progress for an existing qualification handle without queueing new web_fetch work or changing lead records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads status, records, and imported lead ids for a Leadbay import.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches import status from the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, and import diagnostics are returned only to the current chat.
justifications.destructive_justification: Polls an existing import record without uploading rows, changing mappings, or starting processing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uses Leadbay lead-resolution and optional lead hydration to preview identity matches for import rows.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to resolve row identities against Leadbay data, without posting the rows to public or email systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Produces candidate row-to-lead matches without creating imports or writing CRM values.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads candidate seed companies for a lens extra-refill.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for refill seed candidates and keeps the candidate list inside that workspace response.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns refill candidates for review without queueing a refill or consuming quota.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the CRM mappable-field catalog; when sample rows are supplied it uploads a preview CSV via POST /imports, creating an import record on the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to read CRM fields and optionally create a preview import record, with no public URL, third-party post, or outbound email.
justifications.destructive_justification: Lists importable CRM fields and can create a preview import record for sample-row inspection without applying mappings to leads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the Leadbay sector taxonomy, using organization language resolution when available.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace or packaged taxonomy path to return sector definitions, without sending taxonomy choices to public or third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns sector options for audience building without changing any lens filter.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads lead and contact data to build an outreach brief; with the optional enrich: true argument it launches a paid contact enrichment that consumes the account's credit quota.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace for lead and contact context, and optional enrichment stays within that Leadbay workspace rather than being published, posted, or emailed to a third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: Builds an outreach brief and, only when enrich is true, starts contact enrichment that spends the account's Leadbay credit quota.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a user-approved friction report payload that the MCP server emits as a PostHog telemetry event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends only the user-approved friction report fields to PostHog through the MCP telemetry hook and performs no Leadbay backend write, Stripe action, public post, or email.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reports diagnostic friction telemetry to PostHog without mutating Leadbay workspace records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Marks a Leadbay notification as seen or archived through the notification acknowledgement path.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates notification acknowledgement state in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, without posting or emailing notification content outside the account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes notification visibility state by marking it seen or archived while leaving the underlying lead, import, or enrichment job unchanged.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns static artifact component runtime metadata and usage guidance with no backend call.
justifications.open_world_justification: Serves packaged local artifact-kit content and reaches no Leadbay API, Stripe, Sentry, PostHog, public URL, or email destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Provides local component metadata without changing workspace records, files, memory, telemetry, or billing state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Selects Leadbay leads, launches bulk web-fetch qualification, clears the transient selection, and polls qualification reads.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to select leads and start web_fetch qualification, keeping qualification results within the private workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Issues POST /leads/selection/web_fetch?force_fetch=false after POST /leads/selection/select, which starts AI web qualification for the selected leads and can consume the account's qualification quota before clearing selection.

justifications.read_only_justification: Selects leads, previews title enrichment, optionally launches paid email or phone enrichment, and clears the transient selection.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to preview and possibly launch contact enrichment, with enriched contact data remaining inside that Leadbay account.
justifications.destructive_justification: When confirm and channel flags authorize launch, POST /leads/selection/enrichment/launch starts paid email or phone enrichment for selected titles and consumes AI-credit quota.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates, drafts, updates, or activates Leadbay lens filters based on the requested audience change.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to read sectors, lenses, and filters and then write the requested audience changes, without public posting or email delivery.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /lenses/{id}/filter overwrites the saved audience filter for a user lens, org lens, or draft lens, and the cleanup path can issue DELETE /lenses/{id} to remove a failed orphan draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the organization's audience prompt and may answer a generated clarification through Leadbay.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes the new audience prompt to the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, and prompt text is not published to a public page or emailed to an outside party.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /organizations/{orgId}/user_prompt replaces the organization's prior audience prompt and triggers intelligence regeneration, so the previous prompt no longer drives scoring.

justifications.read_only_justification: Posts an answer to the pending Leadbay audience clarification and triggers intelligence regeneration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the clarification answer to the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, where it becomes workspace scoring input rather than a public post or third-party email.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /organizations/{orgId}/pick_clarification records the answer as the organization's user prompt and clears the pending clarification.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes verified outreach notes and optional epilogue status, or returns a dry-run preview when requested.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes outreach activity into the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace only, and it does not send emails or publish the outreach note outside Leadbay.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /leads/{id}/notes appends outreach audit notes and POST /leads/epilogue can change outreach disposition for the selected leads after required verification.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends explicit user-authored feedback to the Leadbay team's Sentry feedback inbox through the MCP feedback hook.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reaches Sentry to deliver the user's feedback to the Leadbay team and does not write Leadbay workspace records, create Stripe billing objects, or post the message publicly.
justifications.destructive_justification: Delivers a feedback report to Sentry while leaving Leadbay account data and billing state unchanged.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uploads lead records, updates import mappings, and may start backend import processing unless dry_run prevents the commit.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends import rows and mappings to the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, creating private account import records rather than public posts or third-party emails.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /imports creates an import record and POST /imports/{id}/update_mappings commits mappings that can create or update lead CRM records in the customer's workspace.

justifications.read_only_justification: Imports lead records and then starts qualification work unless preview, dry-run, or already-qualified checks prevent it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to upload imports and launch qualification, keeping imported companies and scoring results private to that account.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /imports creates import records, mapping commits create or update leads, and follow-on web_fetch qualification can consume qualification quota.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new contact on a Leadbay lead.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes the contact into the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace and does not email that contact, post it publicly, or send it to a third-party CRM.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /leads/{leadId}/contacts adds a contact record to the selected lead while preserving existing contacts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Archives a contact so it leaves the active contact list for its Leadbay lead.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates the contact archive state inside the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, with no public posting or external email action.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /contacts/{contactId}/archive archives the contact and removes it from the lead's active contact list.

justifications.read_only_justification: Pins an existing contact as preferred in Leadbay.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes the pin state inside the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace and does not share contact details outside the account.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /contacts/{contactId}/pin marks the selected contact as pinned for ranking and display.

justifications.read_only_justification: Unpins an existing Leadbay contact.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes the unpin state in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, without posting, emailing, or publishing contact information elsewhere.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /contacts/{contactId}/unpin removes the pinned preference from that contact while keeping the contact record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates editable fields on an existing Leadbay contact.
justifications.open_world_justification: Saves contact edits in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace only, with no public URL, outbound email, or third-party CRM write.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /contacts/{contactId}/update changes the contact's stored fields and returns the updated contact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an organization CRM custom field unless if_not_exists reuses an existing field.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes CRM field metadata to the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace and does not expose field definitions outside the account.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /crm/custom_fields adds a reusable CRM field definition or returns an existing matching definition.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates a CRM custom field definition after reading the current definition.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads and writes CRM field metadata in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, with no publication or external notification.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /crm/custom_fields/{id} changes the selected custom field's stored name, type, or config while preserving the field record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a CRM custom field only when confirm is true.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads and deletes CRM field metadata in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, and the field definition is not sent to outside systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: After confirm: true, DELETE /crm/custom_fields/{id} permanently removes the custom field and drops its values from every lead that used it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces, appends, or removes the organization's Leadbay qualification questions after reading the current list.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes qualification-question changes to the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, keeping scoring criteria inside that workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /organizations/{orgId} replaces the full ai_agent_lead_questions array, and confirm: true is required when the change drops any existing question.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds a note to a Leadbay lead.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes the note to the selected lead in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, without emailing it or publishing it externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /leads/{leadId}/notes appends a durable note to the lead's activity history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Marks a lead as liked in Leadbay.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates liked state for one lead in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, with no external publication or message delivery.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /leads/{leadId}/like records positive lead preference used by Leadbay workflows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Marks a lead as disliked and removes it from the active prospecting path.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates disliked state for one lead in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace and does not notify third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /leads/{leadId}/dislike records negative lead preference and removes the lead from active prospecting surfaces.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sets org-wide CRM status and optional status date for one or more Leadbay leads.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes lead status values in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, without sending status changes to external CRM, email, or public systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /leads/{leadId}/set_status overwrites the org-wide CRM status, and POST /leads/{leadId}/set_status_date overwrites the status date when supplied.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a Leadbay campaign, optionally seeded with lead ids.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates campaign state inside the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace and does not post the campaign or email its membership externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /campaigns creates a durable campaign record and can attach the supplied seed leads at creation time.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds selected Leadbay leads to an existing campaign.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates campaign membership in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, with no public sharing or email notification.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /campaigns/{id}/leads persists new campaign membership for the supplied lead ids, changing how that campaign is used.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes selected leads from a Leadbay campaign.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes campaign membership in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace and sends no campaign data to outside systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: DELETE /campaigns/{id}/leads removes the supplied lead ids from that campaign's saved membership.

justifications.read_only_justification: Requests an additive extra-refill job for a lens after quota and preview checks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace to preview and possibly queue additional leads for a lens, keeping refill results inside the account.
justifications.destructive_justification: POST /lenses/{id}/extra_refill queues an additive refill job that expands the lens's candidate lead pool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists lenses and can switch the active lens, edit lens metadata, or delete a lens when parameters request it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads and writes lens state in the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace, with lens definitions never published to a public URL or emailed externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: With confirm: true, DELETE /lenses/{id} permanently removes the selected non-default lens and its saved audience filter; other modes use POST /lenses/{id} for metadata edits or POST /lenses/{id}/update_last_requested for active-lens switching.

justifications.read_only_justification: Previews a new lens by default and, when confirm is true, creates the lens and applies sector, size, and geography criteria.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates the new lens inside the customer's private Leadbay api-us or api-fr workspace only, without posting, publishing, or emailing the audience definition outside Leadbay.
justifications.destructive_justification: After confirm: true, POST /lenses creates a new lens and POST /lenses/{id}/filter applies its audience criteria, with rollback deletion only if the filter write fails.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reveals contact details for a chosen lead by launching a paid enrichment against the user's Leadbay account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the contact to Leadbay's enrichment provider through the user's own private workspace; the revealed details land on that account and are not published or emailed anywhere.
justifications.destructive_justification: Consumes enrichment quota, which is not refundable, and writes the revealed email or phone onto the contact record; it removes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads or changes the account's product-usage telemetry preference, depending on whether the action argument is status, enable or disable.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes a single preference flag on the user's own Leadbay account; it sends nothing to a public destination or third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: Flips one opt-in flag that the user can flip back at any time; no lead, contact or account data is altered.

test_cases.description: Pull the day's fresh, AI-scored prospects — the app's core daily workflow.
test_cases.expected_output: A ranked list of the account's fresh prospects with a fit score, a short why-it-fits rationale, and the recommended contact for each.

test_cases.description: Look a named company up by name and summarise what the account already knows about it. The name is explicit so the case stands alone.
test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me what we know about CEGEDIM.
test_cases.expected_output: A single company card for CEGEDIM: qualification signals and score, contacts with titles, recent web findings, and prior notes or activity if any exist.

test_cases.description: Draft outreach for a named lead. Verifies the app drafts but never sends.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft me a personalised outreach email for that company.
test_cases.expected_output: An outreach package: the recommended contact, the angle to lead with, and two or three draft variants. Nothing is sent — the user copies or edits the draft themselves.

test_cases.description: Plan in-person visits for a trip to a city, mixing existing accounts with new prospects.
test_cases.user_prompt: I'm visiting Paris next week — which leads should I go and see?
test_cases.expected_output: A city-scoped visit list mixing existing customers, already-qualified leads and fresh prospects, each with a mode badge, a one-line reason to go, and the contact to ask for. If the account holds no known accounts in that city, the app says so rather than padding the list.

test_cases.description: Log outreach the user actually performed. Exercises a write path with the app's verification requirement.
test_cases.user_prompt: I just emailed their VP of Sales — log that against the company.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirmation that the activity was recorded on the lead, carrying the verification reference the user supplied. The app asks for verification rather than logging an unconfirmed send.

negative_test_cases.description: General web or market research is out of scope — the app only works the user's own pipeline.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Research the latest news about Apple stock and summarise analyst reactions.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked. This is open-web market research, not a lookup against the user's Leadbay pipeline.

negative_test_cases.description: The app drafts and logs outreach but never sends mail. A send request must not route here.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this email to jane@example.com from my Gmail account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked. It has no send capability — it prepares drafts and records outreach the user reports having sent.

negative_test_cases.description: Other CRMs are out of scope. Only Leadbay records are readable or writable.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Update my Salesforce opportunity stage for Acme to Closed Won.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked. It can only change records in the user's Leadbay workspace, not in Salesforce.
